For the twelve months ended December 31st, 2017 vs December 31st, 2016, Omeros reported revenue of $64.83MM vs $41.62MM (up 55.77%) and analysts estimated basic earnings per share -$1.17 vs -$1.65. Analysts expect earnings to be released on March 7th, 2019. The report will be for the fiscal period ending December 31st, 2018. The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was -$0.25.
